resources.string: ApexTuner grants access only for the lifetime Premium purchase reported as PURCHASED by Google Play, never while it is PENDING. This build is intentionally client-only: purchase acknowledgement occurs through Play Billing on-device and no purchase token is sent to an ApexTuner server.
Restore re-queries your one-time lifetime Premium purchase from Google Play. A pending transaction does not unlock Premium until Play reports PURCHASED.
